title: Y-12/Oak Ridge legacy program studying the skin of two recovered saucers

tellings.quote: he has stated he has worked under the Y12 complex which houses Oak Ridge on a UFO legacy program that studies the skin of two recovered uh non-human saucer craft.

plain: An online researcher who goes by UAPGerb tells a podcast host, Jesse Michels, about a man who says he worked at the Y-12 complex, a government site at Oak Ridge, Tennessee. According to this man, he was part of a long-running secret programme that studies the outer skin of two recovered saucer-shaped craft built by non-humans, and UAPGerb also names the research organisations MITRE and Battelle. If true, it would mean the US government holds and studies craft that were not made by people.
